hints.title: Check Cardinality Invariance
hints.text: If any number appears more than k times, by pigeonhole principle it is impossible, return negative one.

hints.title: Precompute Valid Subsets
hints.text: Identify all subsets of size n / k having strictly distinct numbers and calculate their max minus min incompatibility.

hints.title: Bitmask Dynamic Programming
hints.text: Compute dp[mask] as the minimum total incompatibility to partition the elements specified in mask.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Partitioning combinations grow rapidly without submask dynamic programming.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bitmask DP over 2^16 states runs in well under one second for n <= 16.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies pigeonhole impossibility early and iterates valid submasks.
